integrity: The envelope is proved from a unique mixture representation and exact concave-hull calculation. Finite computation only replays identities and examples. The verified online-publication date 2006-07-28 is used for the archive source rather than inventing a day for the 1985 print issue.
scientific_limitations: The exact envelope is proved for symmetric unimodal integer-valued laws and integer thresholds.
The result does not solve the asymmetric lattice-unimodal problem.
The originality search was targeted; equivalent older lattice terminology remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp lattice Gauss envelope for symmetric unimodal laws
